codes.means: the file has no YAML header, or its kind is not superobjective
codes.fix: give superobjective.md the header in the standard, or move the file out of the superobjectives home

codes.means: superobjective_version, root, status or visibility is outside the standard, or the statement or the owner(s) is missing
codes.fix: set the key to a value the standard allows; the header table lists them

codes.means: the record names no standard, the bare unversioned URL (written before versions), or another kind's; or its body has no generated "What this file is" note
codes.fix: superobjective stamp self/calling/superobjectives --apply

codes.means: the record names a version of the superobjective standard that the installed package does not implement (from the future, or retired without a migration)
codes.fix: install a version of @supersuit/superobjective that implements it; a record is never downgraded

codes.means: the id is not kebab-case, is not the folder name, supersedes itself, or reuses another record's id (retired included)
codes.fix: name the folder after the id; a new superobjective takes a new id

codes.means: by, set or a sign's by is absent or not an exact YYYY-MM-DD
codes.fix: write the exact date as YYYY-MM-DD

codes.means: the statement uses relative time ("next October", "within twelve months", "a year from now")
codes.fix: superobjective reword with the exact date written into the sentence

codes.means: the date in the statement is not the header's by, or the statement names no date
codes.fix: make the sentence's date and by the same date, through reword, raise or lower

codes.means: by is under 183 or over 548 days from set
codes.fix: check the date is about a year out; six to eighteen months is accepted

codes.means: the body's bold statement line is missing or differs from the header statement
codes.fix: restore the bold line, or change the statement through reword, which keeps both in step

codes.means: more than three active personal superobjectives for one owner, or more than three active company ones for one organization
codes.fix: close, retire or lower one into a recurrent before setting another

codes.means: the active ranks in a group are not exactly 1..n
codes.fix: superobjective rerank with every active id once

codes.means: an active superobjective has fewer than three or more than seven signs
codes.fix: superobjective add-sign, or lower to drop one

codes.means: a sign has no kebab-case id, a repeated id, no text, or a state outside open, met, missed
codes.fix: give each sign a unique kebab-case id, text and a state of open, met or missed

codes.means: a sign has no number, date, named thing or yes/no event
codes.fix: reword the sign so an observation could show it was not met

codes.means: a line of ratchet.jsonl or calibrations.jsonl is not a JSON object
codes.fix: repair the line; the logs are append-only, one JSON object per line

codes.means: no ratchet line records the state, or the header's statement, by, rank, status or signs differ from the last after
codes.fix: make the change through a superobjective writer (raise, reword, lower, add-sign, meet-sign, close, retire, visibility), which records it

codes.means: by moved later or a sign was removed without a lower; or a lower has no why, or was made by someone who is not an owner
codes.fix: superobjective lower --who <owner> --why "<their words>"

codes.means: a personal superobjective is public with no visibility line from its owner saying why
codes.fix: superobjective visibility <home> <id> public --who <owner> --why "<their words>", or set it back to private

codes.means: by has passed and status is still active
codes.fix: superobjective close --achieved or --missed

codes.means: a superproject's serves is not <personal|company>/<id>#<sign>
codes.fix: write serves as <root>/<id>#<sign>

codes.means: serves names no active superobjective, or no such sign on it
codes.fix: point serves at an active superobjective and one of its signs

codes.means: a company superproject serves a personal superobjective
codes.fix: a company superproject serves only a company superobjective
